name: Ruin Palm
description: Strike a latch or hinge or buckle with a palm that ruins the metal inside it.

name: Rubbling Guard
description: Hold a forearm that breaks a heavy weapon into loose pieces when it lands.

name: Cleft Step
description: Step across a cleft that opens beneath the pursuer's next stride.

name: Chip Flick
description: Flick a chip of breaking qi at the edge of a blade so a piece of it flies off.

name: Unseat Grip
description: Unseat the foe's hands from the haft with a twisting pull on both wrists.

name: Armour Unmaking
description: Drive unmaking qi into a plate until its temper fails and it splits like old wood.

name: Breach Press
description: Press a palm to a raised shield and break the arm behind it free of its hold.

name: Latch Ruin
description: Ruin the lock of a chest or door with a single heel-of-hand blow and leave it hanging.

name: Ruinous Wave
description: Send a wave of ruin through the ground and everything built on it before the user.

name: Demolishing Palm
description: Strike with a palm that demolishes a thick door or a plate or a stone lintel in one pass.

name: Unmaking Fingertip
description: Press a fingertip to a single point on a foe's gear and unmake the piece at that point.

name: Dissolve Ward
description: Dissolve a thrown spark of qi at the edge of the field before it reaches the body.

name: Null Slide
description: Slide along the edge of the field where the techniques of the foe come undone.

name: Unstitch Flick
description: Flick a mote of unmaking at the stitches of a qi weave and watch it part.

name: Technique Erasure
description: Erase one technique as it forms in the field and leave the foe's hands empty.

name: Fraying Quell
description: Hold the field over a foe so that his gathering qi comes apart as fast as it collects.

name: Spell Unbinding
description: Unbind a single binding spell about an ally by unmaking its knot inside the field.

name: Wide Unmaking
description: Spread the field wide so that each technique cast inside it comes undone one instance at a time.

name: Wide Nullity
description: Hold a wide nullity about the user and allies that unmakes every bolt of qi that crosses it.

name: Double Crack
description: Strike twice at one point so that the second blow joins the crack the first began.

name: Splintered Ward
description: Cross both forearms and let a blow splinter on the join where they meet.

name: Faultwalk
description: Walk along the faults in a floor or a road so that the footing holds only for the user.

name: Cracklash
description: Whip a line of breaking qi across a shield face and split its coating.

name: Cross Cleft
description: Strike left and right across a plank so the two clefts meet and drop a piece out.

name: Binding Snap
description: Snap the cord that ties the foe's weapon to his wrist with a pair of tugs.

name: Second Fracture
description: Land a second blow along the line of the first so the crack opens through the target.

name: Fracture Chain
description: Send a chain of fractures running outward from the strike across the ground in a fan.

name: Chain Release
description: Fracture the links of a curse-chain on an ally one after the other until it falls.

name: Chain Fracture
description: Run a line of fractures in two directions at once through every structure it meets.

name: Double Ruin
description: Bring two ruinous blows down on a single mass until it parts between them.

name: Breach Palm
description: Strike a barred door with a palm that breaches the bar at its middle.

name: Cleft Guard
description: Hold a guard whose edge clefts a heavy weapon down the middle.

name: Breach Drop
description: Drop through a breach the moment it opens and land low behind the line.

name: Unmaking Needle
description: Flick a needle of unmaking qi that pricks through a weave of ward-thread.

name: Seal Snap
description: Snap the wax or thread of a seal on a satchel with a flick of the nail.

name: Breaching Rush
description: Rush a shoulder through a warded door and break the ward as it passes.

name: Barrier Unmaking
description: Unmake one qi barrier raised before the user and leave the rest of the field standing.

name: Seal Remedy
description: Unmake a sealing laid on an ally's meridians and let the blocked qi run again.

name: Great Breach
description: Drive through a thick ward or a plated hull in one breach that stays open.

name: Barrier Collapse
description: Collapse every qi barrier within the field at once and shake the foes behind them.

name: Gale Unmake
description: Strike on the crest of a gust so the blow unmakes the weakest point it meets.

name: Shearing Guard
description: Shear a thrust off its line with a forearm swept across it like a crosswind.

name: Breakstep
description: Step out of a hold with a gust and leave the foe's grip broken behind.

name: Splinter Gust
description: Loose a gust that carries splinters of breaking qi into a foe's guard.

name: Gale Dissolution
description: Send a gale that dissolves loose structure and ties across a wide arc.

name: Windborne Quell
description: Carry a pulse of unmaking on the wind that disrupts a distant foe's gathering move.

name: Sworn Sundering
description: Sunder a single chosen target while leaving all sworn to the wind untouched.

name: Gale Annulment
description: Raise a gale that annuls the force of missiles and bolts of qi that enter it.

name: Bearing Fault
description: Fix a bearing on the foe's weakest joint and break it with one straight blow.

name: Aimed Fracture
description: Fracture a chosen board or stave at the exact spot the bearing reveals.

name: Breakline Guard
description: Hold the arms along the line of the foe's blow so that it breaks on their edge.

name: Breakslant
description: Step on a slant off the line so the foe's breaking blow falls wide.

name: Sighted Flick
description: Flick a thread of unmaking along a sighted line to the fault of a distant piece.

name: Mark Snap
description: Snap the foe's grip at the one finger the bearing marks as weakest.

name: Sighted Ruin
description: Drive ruin along a sighted line through three layers of armour in one thrust.

name: Brink Collapse
description: Strike a post at the point the bearing marks and drop the whole weight resting on it.

name: Bearing Quell
description: Hold the bearing on a foe's gathering qi and keep it coming apart.

name: Marked Unbinding
description: Take a bearing on the knot of a binding curse in an ally and unmake only that knot.

name: Bearing Demolition
description: Demolish a thick wall or a shield line along the bearing in one long drive.

name: Mark Annulment
description: Annul the force of an attack the moment the bearing marks its source.
